title: His three brothers and their ages
summary: His brothers Henry, Leonce and Sanford all played instruments; he is the eldest, Sanford born 1903, and Leonce and Henry have died.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: How many brothers did you have? Three. Did they all play music?

Yeah. They all played trombos, string bass, guitar, mandolin. And my second, the fellow under me used to play guitar, only. That was Henry. And my younger brother, he played with Pangelline for a while. He played trap drums.

And what's his name? Sanford. Sanford. They call him Sam? Sam. Sam. And what's the difference in ages there? Oh, I'll be 73 pretty soon. And how old would Leonce be if he were alive? Leonce would be about 68. So you're the oldest. I'm the oldest. And Sanford is the youngest. Youngest. And he's how much younger than you?
Oh, plenty younger. He was born, I think that was in 1903. Mm-hmm. 1903 was born. He was born the year that my daddy died.
And, uh, Henry? Henry was two years younger than I was.
Are the other two still living? Henry and Sam? No. Sam is living, but Henry and Leonce are both dead. Henry died about two years after Leonce.
